prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity landscape native mobile puzzle game level-selection screen, redesign reference for production implementation.
Input image: the attached image is the existing RacingClub screen. Preserve its hand-painted equestrian arena background, left horse artwork, forest green/cream/wood palette, 5 difficulty groups and 4-by-4 grid of 16 levels.
Primary request: redesign the five difficulty buttons and sixteen challenge buttons to feel like premium equestrian game objects rather than generic dashboard cards. Remove the question-mark help button from the top-right entirely. Keep the screen airy and legible on a landscape phone. Reduce the oversized top branding slightly to give the buttons room.
Difficulty row: five distinct rank tabs in one row with small circular engraved Roman-numeral medallions I, II, III, IV, V. Labels 入门 / 初级 / 专家 / 大师 / 宗师 and ranges 01–16 / 17–32 / 33–48 / 49–64 / 65–80. Selected 宗师 uses rich blue, subtle gold highlight and ivory lettering. Other tabs are warm ivory with fine carved edges and their existing green/orange/red/purple accents. Show a clear, elegant selected state.
Challenge buttons: small carved wooden challenge plaques with cream inset faces, softly bevelled lower edges and restrained shadows. Large two-digit level number 65–80 on the left; on the right a small recognizable wooden route puzzle tile thumbnail. At the bottom a compact line of piece/crossing counts. An elegant tiny arrow indicates enter; completed sample cards use a green check seal, one in-progress sample uses a small clock seal. Keep all buttons the same size, easy to tap and readable. Do not add locks, stars, currencies, game mechanics, extra controls, or unnecessary instructional text.
Text: retain RacingClub and 马术训练场. Important names and numbers must be readable; this is a single finished screen, not a presentation board. Keep the existing overall layout proportions, with all sixteen challenge buttons visible. No phone frame, no watermark.
